name: proddoctor
description: Post-deploy checks for real production domains with optional browser evidence, traces and HTML reports.

scripts.check: node ./scripts/check-license.mjs && node --check ./src/checker.mjs && node --check ./src/assets.mjs && node --check ./src/tls.mjs && node --check ./src/browser.mjs && node --check ./src/report.mjs && node --check ./src/html-report.mjs && node --check ./bin/proddoctor.mjs && node --check ./scripts/sync-version.mjs && node --check ./scripts/check-release-policy.mjs && node --check ./scripts/check-release-integrity.mjs && node --check ./scripts/check-pr-title.mjs && npm run version:check && npm test
